playkitSpatial.loading.zh-Hans: 正在准备已批准的 AR 图片

playkitSpatial.purpose.en: Use the camera for spatial placement?
playkitSpatial.purpose.zh-Hans: 使用相机进行空间放置？

playkitSpatial.purposeDetail.en: Recognize a real surface or the configured image, then anchor the returned artwork in the camera view. No camera frames are saved or uploaded, and recognition does not prove arrival or award a result.
playkitSpatial.purposeDetail.zh-Hans: 识别真实平面或配置的图像，将返回的图片固定在相机空间中。不会保存或上传相机画面，识别也不作为到店凭证或奖励判定。

playkitSpatial.findMarker.en: Point the camera at the configured reference image
playkitSpatial.findMarker.zh-Hans: 将相机对准配置的识别图

playkitSpatial.findPlane.en: Move slowly to find a horizontal surface
playkitSpatial.findPlane.zh-Hans: 缓慢移动手机，寻找水平面

playkitSpatial.tapPlane.en: Tap a detected surface to place the card
playkitSpatial.tapPlane.zh-Hans: 点击已识别的平面放置卡片

playkitSpatial.noEvidence.en: Spatial display is visual only; task acceptance remains on the server
playkitSpatial.noEvidence.zh-Hans: 空间展示仅用于观看，任务是否通过仍由服务端决定

playkitSpatial.error.disabled.en: Spatial rendering has not been enabled for this session
playkitSpatial.error.disabled.zh-Hans: 当前会话尚未启用空间渲染

playkitSpatial.error.unvalidatedScan.en: The scan must be validated by the server first
playkitSpatial.error.unvalidatedScan.zh-Hans: 请先由服务端验证扫码结果

playkitSpatial.error.unsupportedMode.en: This spatial mode is not supported
playkitSpatial.error.unsupportedMode.zh-Hans: 暂不支持这种空间模式

playkitSpatial.error.unsupportedModel.en: This model is outside the approved GLB profile or asset origins. Use the returned image instead.
playkitSpatial.error.unsupportedModel.zh-Hans: 这个模型不符合已批准的 GLB 格式或资源来源要求，请改看返回的图片。

playkitSpatial.error.assetUnavailable.en: An approved image could not be loaded. The static fallback remains available.
playkitSpatial.error.assetUnavailable.zh-Hans: 已批准的图片未能加载，仍可使用静态图片回落。

playkitSpatial.error.markerCalibrationRe.en: The reference image needs an accepted physical-width calibration before native tracking can start
playkitSpatial.error.markerCalibrationRe.zh-Hans: 原生图像追踪开始前，需要提供并验收识别图的实际宽度

playkitSpatial.error.permissionDenied.en: Camera permission was not granted; use the image fallback
playkitSpatial.error.permissionDenied.zh-Hans: 相机权限未获准，请使用图片回落

playkitSpatial.error.deviceUnavailable.en: AR could not start or track reliably on this device. Use the image fallback.
playkitSpatial.error.deviceUnavailable.zh-Hans: 此设备未能启动或稳定追踪 AR，请使用图片回落。

playkitSpatial.error.interrupted.en: Spatial viewing was interrupted. No task result was submitted.
playkitSpatial.error.interrupted.zh-Hans: 空间观看已中断，没有提交任务结果。
